name: TOPGLOV
recent: Top Glove 近期公布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日的季度业绩，营收与净利均大幅增长；同时宣布每股 1.50 仙的免税终期股息，并持续有雇员认购凭单与 ESOS 新股上市。此外，公司宣布与 Miti 及 Sirim 合作强化供应商 ESG 实践，市场亦关注其在泰国的潜在扩张。
notable: 宣布每股 1.50 仙的免税终期股息，除息日为 2026 年 11 月 23 日，派发日为 2026 年 12 月 15 日。
与 Miti 及 Sirim 合作，强化中小企业供应商的 ESG 实践。
季度净利达 1.576 亿令吉，较上季增长 94.6%，较去年同期增长 352.6%。
risks: 执行主席 Lim Wee Chai 在闭锁期前表示有意进行证券交易。
雇员公积金局（KWAP）在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报其大股东权益变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日的季度营收为 12.48 亿令吉，环比增长 14.0%，同比增长 39.7%；净利为 1.576 亿令吉，环比增长 94.6%，同比增长 352.6%，净利率从上一季的 7.4% 升至 12.6%。

recent_en: Top Glove recently reported quarterly results for the period ended 31 Aug 2026, with both revenue and net profit rising sharply; it also declared a tax-exempt final dividend of 1.50 sen per share, while new shares continued to be listed from warrant conversions and ESOS exercises. The company also announced a partnership with Miti and Sirim to strengthen ESG practices among suppliers, and the market is watching a potential expansion in Thailand.
notable_en: Declared a tax-exempt final dividend of 1.50 sen per share, with ex-date on 23 Nov 2026 and payment date on 15 Dec 2026.
Partnered with Miti and Sirim to strengthen ESG practices among SME suppliers.
Quarterly net profit reached RM157.6 million, up 94.6% QoQ and 352.6% YoY.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Lim Wee Chai indicated intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
KWAP (Kumpulan Wang Persaraan) filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between October and November.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, revenue was RM1.248 billion, up 14.0% QoQ and 39.7% YoY; net profit was RM157.6 million, up 94.6% QoQ and 352.6% YoY, with net margin rising to 12.6% from 7.4% in the previous quarter.
